steps.action: Reach the Audit log under Security and combine the three filters
steps.actual: Settings > Security > Audit log opened as "Audit log" with columns ["Event","Record","Audience","When"] (the security group needed expanding). The three filters combine and narrow in turn: unfiltered 50 entries, Person="Daniel Okafor" 50, plus Action="contract_type.archived" 2, plus Record="Contract" -1.

steps.action: The From and To bounds use the browser’s local calendar days
steps.actual: The browser runs in Asia/Dubai, so its calendar day is 2026-09-08. Bounding From and To to that day left 50 entries and the query sent ["?from=2019-12-31T20:00:00.000Z&to=2020-01-01T19:59:59.999Z"] — the civil dates become that day's first and last instants in this browser's zone. Bounding to 2020-01-01 matched nothing and the log said "No entry matches these filters.". Clear filters recovered 50 entries.

steps.action: Search narrows the audit text and is not a search of record content
steps.actual: Searching the configuration name "Ind sign-off panel IND81T2F" matched 11 entries, e.g. "Nadia Haddad asked Daniel Okafor to approve this contract, from the Ind sign-off panel IND81T2F group Contract 01a07f8e-870e-76fc-97f1-967ae7779b7b Working team 3 minutes ago". Searching the Request answer text "Fictional budget note that has no home on the Matter type" matched -1 entries and reported "No entry matches these filters." — the Search box narrows recorded audit text, not Contract, Matter, Document or Knowledge content.
